item.description: Vice President, Dr. Mohamed Juldeh Jalloh, joined worshippers Friday at the National Stadium practice field in Freetown for Eid al-Fitr prayers, marking the culmination of Ramadan. His presence among citizens during this solemn occasion reflected shared devotion and collective reverence.Following prayers, Dr. Jalloh commended imams for leading what he described as a peaceful, spiritually uplifting congregation. item.title: Sierra Leone Mission in Saudi Arabia Unites Umrah Pilgrims for Eid Al-Fitr Feast.
item.description: One hundred Sierra Leonean Umrah pilgrims broke their fast together in Makkah on Friday, joining for a celebratory Eid Al-Fitr dinner hosted by their nation’s embassy in partnership with Saudi philanthropist Saleh Zahrani.
